# PasswordResetRequest

Sets a new password with the key from a password-reset e-mail.

**Kind:** an object, used in requests.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `emailAddress` | `string` | yes | The e-mail address of the account. Constraints: format: email, required (empty or whitespace-only strings are rejected). |
| `resetKey` | `string` | yes | The reset key from the e-mail. Constraints: required (empty or whitespace-only strings are rejected). |
| `password` | `string` | yes | The new password: 8 to 15 characters with a lower-case letter, an upper-case letter, a digit and a symbol, or a passphrase of at least 20 characters and four words. Constraints: pattern: ^(?=.*[a-z])(?=.*[A-Z])(?=.*\d)(?=.*[^\da-zA-Z]).{8,15}$|^(?=.{20,}$).+ .+ .+ .+$, required (empty or whitespace-only strings are rejected). |

## Example

```json
{
  "emailAddress": "...",
  "resetKey": "...",
  "password": "..."
}
```
